raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
# What does this PR do ?

Bump the pinned nvidia-modelopt override from 0.48.0rc1 to the official 0.48.0 release.

# Changelog

- Update the override in `pyproject.toml`.
- Update only the ModelOpt override, version, and wheel URL/hash in `uv.lock`. No other locked packages change.
- ModelOpt's base dependencies are unchanged from 0.48.0rc1.

# GitHub Actions CI

CI is pending. Local validation: `uv lock --check` with uv 0.7.2 (matches `UV_VERSION` in `docker/Dockerfile.ci`). No local GPU tests run.

# Before your PR is "Ready for review"

**Pre checks**:

- [x] Read the [Contributor guidelines](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x] No new tests are needed for this dependency-only change.
- [x] No documentation change is needed.
- [x] No imports or optional-install guards change.
  - [ ] Reviewer: Confirm optional-library import guards remain appropriate.

# Additional Information

- ModelOpt [0.48.0 release](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Model-Optimizer/releases/tag/0.48.0).
- Follows #6546 (0.48.0rc1) and #6195 (0.47.0).
